## Download

| Your computer | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) | `…-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with an Intel processor | `…-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 | `…-win-x64.exe` |

If your computer warns you the first time you run it:

- **macOS:** open the `.dmg`, drag the app to Applications, then right-click the app and choose **Open**. If macOS still refuses, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** on the "Windows protected your PC" screen click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
